name: cc-cardinality-reduction
author: DataDay Technology Solutions
description: Detect 25+ high-cardinality patterns (UUIDs, session/trace IDs, emails, JWTs, vendor tokens, K8s ephemeral labels, container hashes, histogram buckets, timestamps, URL paths) and audit them in DRY_RUN — then normalize, drop, or aggregate them before they hit your destination. Ships in audit mode: no event changes shape until you flip one switch.
